question: Should OpenClaw adopt configurable Discord source-message subagent progress as a bundled feature, and what permanent shared lifecycle/API contract should support it?
rationale: The implementation is credible, but deciding whether seven new Discord settings and the new public message-origin/channel-lifecycle surface belong in the supported product and Plugin SDK requires explicit ownership intent rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Approve a narrower generic seam
options.body: Sponsor the Discord feature but require source-message targeting and terminal cleanup to use the smallest channel-neutral internal or existing typed-hook contract before merge.

options.title: Approve the current public seam
options.body: Accept the new DeliveryContext and ChannelLifecycleAdapter contracts as supported Plugin SDK surface, then rebase and validate the exact merged head.

options.title: Decline the bundled feature
options.body: Close the PR if maintainers do not want additional Discord configuration and long-term SDK compatibility burden for progress reactions.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrower generic seam
recommendation.body: Sponsor the Discord feature but require source-message targeting and terminal cleanup to use the smallest channel-neutral internal or existing typed-hook contract before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the documented Discord subsystem owner and is best positioned to decide whether the user-facing behavior and configuration belong in the bundled Discord plugin.
